purpose: This silver table is a cleaned airline carrier reference (dimension) table mapping IATA carrier codes to full airline names, intended to feed joins against flight-level fact tables keyed by carrier code.
usage: Consumers should join downstream flight or booking tables to this table on the carrier column to resolve human-readable airline_name; no filtering of flagged or null rows is required since all columns in this snapshot are fully populated.
limitations: This is a small 16-row snapshot with no historical versioning or effective-dating; duplicate_row_rate was 0.0 at profiling time but this does not guarantee future loads remain duplicate-free, and all Airbyte capture metadata was dropped so lineage to the original extraction batch is not preserved in silver.
